title: Clean Active Window Mark
description: Active window mark should be the same fine line as inactive chrome (1px border-element weight) but with primary (active-base) color instead of a thick ring-2 inset.
summary: Replaced broken CSS subgrid with a flex active column: inactive tabs sit beside (not inside) the U-frame; body lives only under active tab+gap+controls so the primary stroke is continuous on the left/bottom of the active tab without drawing over sibling tabs or a full-width rectangle.
